speakIntro: Pick a topic, press Record, and talk for 30–90 seconds. You'll get your speaking pace, filler words, and tips.
speakNoTranscript: Your browser can record but can't turn speech into text. Listen back and use the checklist below.
speakPaceGood: Great pace! 130–160 words per minute is easy to follow.
speakPaceFast: A little fast. Try pausing after each main idea.
speakPaceSlow: A little slow. Try practicing your main points so the words come easier.
speakFillersGood: Barely any filler words. Nice control!
speakFillersTip: Try a short pause instead of “um” or “like.” Silence sounds confident.
speakTooShort: Try to talk for at least 30 seconds.
speakCheck1: I started with a hook or a clear main idea.
speakCheck2: I gave an example or a story.
speakCheck3: I ended with a strong closing sentence.
speakCheck4: I looked up (or at the camera) instead of reading.
speakAiTips: Get AI tips on my speech
speakMicError: We couldn't use your microphone. Check that your browser has permission.
speakUnsupported: Recording isn't supported in this browser. Try Chrome or Safari.
